about.label: About
bio: My path into product design started in visual and editorial design, and evolved through freelance work and in-house roles into full-scope product design at MyLoyal in Copenhagen, where I've spent the last 5+ years shaping loyalty and engagement experiences for brands across Denmark. That graphic design foundation still shows up in my work today: a stronger-than-average eye for visual craft, typography, and motion, layered on top of research, systems thinking, and interaction design.

Every project starts with the same question: what's actually happening for the person using this, and why? I work iteratively, sketching, testing, refining, staying close to design trends without chasing them, and I'm most useful in the messy middle of a project, turning ambiguous problems into shipped systems that hold up in production. Calm under pressure, observant, and happiest working closely with a team rather than in isolation.
